data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 1686 (merged 2026-08-12T23:27:43Z), commit 'Seed marker counters instead of replaying journals'. LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before submit.

Fix: all six offset sites in infra/scripts/observability.sh now seed prev to the CURRENT total when
the offset file holds no usable count, so the initialising run publishes 0 and the existing
publish-then-persist block writes the total — measurement starts from the next interval. This is the
cold-start complement of the negative-delta clamp (2dc7-31b7-ecbb-4cd2 / change 34759270dd): there
lost history is already-counted, here inherited history is never-monitored. An empty or non-numeric
offset takes the same branch (an unreadable offset is indistinguishable from none); a file holding a
real 0 is unchanged.

Covered by the shared helper AND the open-coded counters in sections 3, 4, 4c, 4d and 4b, so the
next new counter added to any of them cannot repeat this.

Tests: tests/scripts/test_observability_coldstart_e2a6.py — absent offsets against a populated stub
journal publish 0 for all nine metrics (including review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and
review_interrupts_signal_unavailable, the two that fired) and seed the offset to the journal total;
a marker arriving after initialisation still publishes normally, so seeding is not sticky.
RED-verified pre-fix (published 7, expected 0). The 1648 rotation tests and the 6a65
publish-then-persist tests still pass unchanged; the 613a reason-split tests now pre-seed their
offsets at 0, since an absent offset is a cold start and they exercise the split, not initialisation.

Deploy: no manual box action — autodeploy.sh watches OBS_PATHS and re-runs
install-observability.sh on a probe-source change (same path 1648 took).

Follow-on found while landing this: the review of THIS change tripped a different false-positive in
the same file — unanchored marker greps counting the review-bot's own LLM prose as errors — filed
and being fixed as colossal-slothful-grouse (8c2f-8377-5044-4650).
